<thought>The target 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene can be made in a single step by a McMurry coupling of two equivalents of commercially available 4‑methoxybenzaldehyde. This reaction joins the carbonyl carbons of two aldehydes to form the central C=C bond, giving the desired stilbene. 4‑Methoxybenzaldehyde is inexpensive and readily purchasable; the required reductive coupling reagents (TiCl₄ and Zn) are inexpensive and their combined cost is far below the $150 limit. I will locate a suitable McMurry‑type retrosynthetic template and then construct the required JSON route.</thought>
